title: nmea0183: Add GGA sentence dissector
description:
Add sentence dissector for GGA messages.
- It uses the existing dissector for the time field.
- It splits the latitude and longitude into separate degree and minute fields.
- The gps quality reports the human readable values
- Some fields should contain a fixed value, incorrect values are reported
- The other fields are named and simply display their contents
- Add a suffix to some fields to report the unit
- Report an expected but missing field

### Tested

This pcap contains messages including GGA sentences: [nmea-simulator.pcapng](/uploads/548270d368a136cead8df2d76f29c9e1/nmea-simulator.pcapng)

This pcap contains invalid variants of GGA sentence: [nmea-test-messages.pcapng](/uploads/06d4e4d2c3f64606fdadb7d3b591b6c3/nmea-test-messages.pcapng)

I have run 500 iterations of `fuzz-test.sh` with these captures.
